source_authority: Department of Food and Public Distribution, Government of India
text: The official Mera Ration FAQ says the app is a National Informatics Centre mobile application for ration-card beneficiaries to access information about their ration-card system and food-grain entitlements under the National Food Security Act. Its listed features include viewing ration-card details, checking monthly food entitlements, viewing past food-grain transactions, and locating nearby Fair Price Shops.
title: Mera Ration App - purpose and features

section: One Nation One Ration Card portability
source_authority: Department of Food and Public Distribution, Government of India
text: The official FAQ describes One Nation One Ration Card as allowing NFSA beneficiaries to collect their food-grain entitlement from any Fair Price Shop across India by using their existing ration card.
title: One Nation One Ration Card - portability

source_authority: Department of Food and Public Distribution, Government of India
text: To check a food-grain entitlement, the official Mera Ration FAQ directs users to the app dashboard, which displays the quantity and type of food grains the beneficiary is eligible to receive each month.
title: Mera Ration App - check food entitlement

source_authority: Department of Food and Public Distribution, Government of India
text: The official FAQ says users can submit a grievance through the Mera Ration app and monitor the status of its redressal in the app.
title: Mera Ration App - grievance submission and tracking
